report.source_text: Cardiac ultrasound revealed situs solitus, levocardia, normal atrio-ventricular connections, and normal pulmonary venous return (PVR), intact interatrial septum (IAS) and interventricular septum (IVS). A mild LV contractile dysfunction was observed, with LVEF of 53% and 0-I scale mitral regurgitation. The heart ultrasound values were the following: interventricular septum (IVS) = 8 mm, left ventricle posterior wall thickness (LVPWs) = 9 mm, right ventricular end-diastolic volume (RVEDV) = 54 mm, left ventricular end-diastolic volume (LVEDV) = 39 mm, left atrium (LA) = 34 mm, right ventricle (RV) = 25 mm, right atrium (RA) = 36 mm, and left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) = 53%.

report.source_text: Thus, antiarrhythmic treatment with amiodarone was initiated during the treatment; the PR interval was prolonged, so it was decided to transfer the patient to the Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases and Transplantation in Târgu Mureş, a center specializing in ICD placement in children. In the absence of specific guidelines, it was decided by the multidisciplinary team that the benefits outweighed the risks, and the patient was scheduled for the implantation of a bicameral cardiac defibrillator.

clinician.final_diagnosis: Emery-Dreifuss Muscular Dystrophy due to LMNA mutation
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 16-year-old female with family history of dilated cardiomyopathy presented with mild COVID-19 symptoms but had stage 2 hypertension and elevated cardiac markers. Genetic testing revealed a heterozygous c.448A > C (p.Thr150Pro) mutation in the LMNA gene. Clinical exam one month later showed musculoskeletal signs typical for Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy, including gait disturbance, Achilles tendon contractures, and limited arm and ankle extension with preserved reflexes. Cardiac ultrasound revealed mild left ventricular dysfunction (LVEF 53%) and mild mitral regurgitation. Holter monitoring identified first-degree AV block, non-sustained ventricular tachycardia, and ventricular extrasystoles. The patient was started on amiodarone and scheduled for bicameral ICD implantation.
